name: Gear wall
summary: A club's gear closet drawn as two wooden shelves of gear; whatever is out leaves a dashed outline with the borrower's face and a back-by tag, overdue tags turn red and wobble, and members tap a thing, pick a day and borrow it.
useWhen: who has the club stove, we need it saturday
can we track who borrows the outing club gear
whoever has the cooler pls bring it back
borrowing the bear canister till tuesday ok?
dontUseWhen: shared house stuff on a hook by the door (use key-hook)
selling or giving gear away (use marketplace tools)
packing a list for one trip (use bring-list)

asked.description: The item someone just asked about, by its name; it starts selected

holder.description: Who has it now; empty if on the shelf

said.description: What the holder said, in their words
